meta.name: historical-interview-scripts
meta.description: 自媒体创作者在策划历史名人访谈短视频时，当需要融合古今反差与网络热梗打造爆款，使用本技能可自动生成包含吸睛标题、主持人串词与爆笑问答的完整结构化脚本，轻松产出高传播力的趣味短视频文案。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把历史名人访谈变成自带热梗的爆笑短视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是做历史类短视频的创作者,想快速产出有梗的访谈脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn historical figure interviews into viral short-video scripts with internet memes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a short-video creator making history content and need quick meme-driven interview scripts

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按固定结构写出历史名人虚构访谈的短视频文案:标题与封面文案、本期嘉宾梗概、主持人开场串词、主持人提问配名人回答,以及结尾互动引导,并把网络热梗融进对话。
howto.when: 当你要求创作历史人物访谈、趣味历史内容或短视频文案时触发;也可指定人物、要求脑洞联动或系列创作。

say.text: 帮我写一期李白和杜甫的访谈短视频文案
say.note: 输出标题、串词与问答结构全文

say.text: 用秦始皇、武则天、朱元璋写「古代CEO的管理哲学」
say.note: 按该主题生成完整脚本

say.text: 写李清照吐槽苏轼,多加点热梗
say.note: 输出含跨界互怼的访谈片段

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes short-video scripts for fictional talk-show interviews with historical figures: title/cover copy, guest summary, host intro, host questions with comedic answers, and a closing call to interact, with internet memes woven into the dialogue.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for interviews with historical figures, fun history content, or short-video scripts; you can also name the figures, request cross-era mashups, or ask for a series.

say_en.text: Write a short-video interview script with Li Bai and Du Fu
say_en.note: Outputs title, host lines, and Q&A structure

say_en.text: Use Qin Shi Huang, Wu Zetian and Zhu Yuanzhang for 'ancient CEO management philosophy'
say_en.note: Generates a full script on that theme

say_en.text: Have Li Qingzhao roast Su Shi, add more memes
say_en.note: Outputs interview segments with cross-era banter
